## Klaven Foot Soldier (CR 1/2)

**XP** 200  
 Male klaven warrior 1  
 LE Medium humanoid (augmented humanoid, human)  
 **Init** +4; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception –1  

**Defense**

 **AC** 14, touch 10, flat-footed 14 (+4 natural)  
 **hp** 17 (1d10+7)  
 **Fort** +5, **Ref** +0, **Will** +1; +2 vs. disease, ingested poison, and becoming nauseated or sickened  
 **Defensive Abilities** plagueborn; **Immune** fear  
 **Weaknesses** malign influence  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 30 ft.  
 **Melee** battleaxe +5 (1d8+4/x3) or 2 claws +4 (1d6+3)  
 **Ranged** spur rifle +1 (1d6/19–20 plus poison)  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 17, **Dex** 11, **Con** 16, **Int** 8, **Wis** 9, **Cha** 8  
 **Base Atk** +1; **CMB** +4; **CMD** 14  
 **Feats** [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), Iron Will, [Weapon Focus (battleaxe)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md), [Improved Initiative](../../rules/feats/improved-initiative.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Endurance and Toughness are one feat, Toughness; Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (battleaxe), Improved Initiative.*  
 **Skills** Climb +7, Intimidate +7; **Racial Modifiers** +4 Intimidate  
 **Languages** Common, Ultari  
 **SQ** converted host, energy modulation (1/day), nanite exchange  
 **Gear** battleaxe, spur rifle with 5 spurs
